_comment: Independent B24 equipment-reassessment witness: the source-selected untamed pickup reaches the out-of-sight equipment boundary after sixteen searches. Its final frames have no pickup or wear text, so the recording is not counted as visible proof of an equipped item; the source-pinned runtime test records the monster/item/worn-mask/frozen transition. The seed, clock, character, and searches were selected independently of the fixed holdout. The second segment keeps the same route with verbose output disabled as a cheap message-arm variation.
